message.content: which espresso machine are we ordering

content.text: We are going with the Rocket R58. It fits the counter and the budget, so I have put it forward as the order.

message.content: the R58 is plumbed-in only and we have no water line

content.text: I was wrong about the Rocket R58 — it cannot run on a tank in the model we priced.
The order is the Lelit Bianca. It runs from a tank or a line, and it is the machine we are ordering.
